meta.name: Polymarket Copy-Trade Paper Log
meta.purpose: Separate system from sports betting. Paper-track copied positions (ALL market types) in UNITS to prove the copy edge beats slippage BEFORE real money.
meta.unitNote: 1 unit = $5. You COPY THE SIDE AND PRICE, not the dollar amount. The trader bets their whole bankroll (often $10k-$200k); you stake a flat 1 unit. traderSize = the copied wallet's position size, shown only for context.
meta.rules: Curated slate: copy consensus (2+ top wallets) OR high-conviction positions from the strongest wallets, still copyable near entry. VERIFY sports matchups + dates against the real league schedule before logging (skip stale/old markets). Skip coin-flips and late entries. Grade on CLV-style edge, not just W/L.
